record.title: Evaluate whole-sequence controls and admit a bounded stock validation
record.intent: Choose one stock sequence-validation run or an evidence-led observer correction.
requirements: Evaluate the frozen private results without reclassifying negatives. Identify whether whole-sequence observation preserves synchronization, catches divergence and covers required threads.

If supported admit exactly one stock whole-sequence validation with entry checks, explicit synthetic logging readbacks and the unexecuted post-return PC0x333bac. Stop at divergence or that boundary; no next-subsystem response is included.
If unsupported identify the smallest bounded correction or architecture decision. Draft plan inspect admit against the expected revision and commit and push tasking before execution.
acceptance: A supported bounded successor or exact unresolved limitation is committed and pushed.
